create_viewer_window: create a Viewer instance with a given width and height to render 2D geometry
render_scene_to_rgb: render the Viewer scene and return an RGB numpy array of the current frame
draw_shapes_on_viewer: draw circles, polygons, polylines, or lines on a Viewer using convenience draw methods
create_capsule_geometry: create a capsule compound geometry from a given length and width for rendering
display_image_array: display a numpy image array in a SimpleImageViewer window with optional scaling
